title: Fantastic Metrics and How to Find Them: Meta-Evaluating Metrics for Multi-lingual Style-Personalized Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Meta-evaluation of text generation metrics and LLM-judges is primarily conducted using metric-human correlations. However, prior work has shown that correlation is not an appropriate estimate of a metric's evaluation capability and can be unstable across evaluation settings, such as different datasets or languages. Therefore, we propose a regression-based meta-evaluation of metrics that learns on calibrated metric outputs to predict human ratings. We ground this measurement relative to a trivial constant-mean baseline and human agreements to provide a comparable measure of metric capability across evaluation settings. To test our meta-evaluation framework, we developed a large-scale multi-lingual style-personalized text generation (SPTG) benchmark, collecting multiple annotations across 10 topologically diverse languages and four evaluation dimensions, each with varying degrees of subjectivity. translated_title: 奇妙的指标及其寻找方法：面向多语言风格个性化生成的指标元评估
translated_abstract: 文本生成指标和大语言模型判官的元评估主要采用指标与人类评分之间的相关性来进行。然而，先前的研究表明，相关性并非衡量指标评估能力的恰当方式，且在不同评估设置（如不同数据集或语言）下可能不稳定。因此，我们提出了一种基于回归的指标元评估方法，该方法通过在校准后的指标输出上学习来预测人类评分。我们将这一测量相对于一个简单的常数均值基线以及人类评分者间一致性进行校准，从而提供一种跨评估设置可比较的指标能力度量。为了检验我们的元评估框架，我们构建了一个大规模的多语言风格个性化文本生成（SPTG）基准，在10种拓扑结构多样的语言和四个具有不同程度主观性的评估维度上收集了多条人工标注。我们对来自三种风格……的32个指标进行了元评估。
tldr: 提出基于回归的指标元评估框架，以预测人类评分替代传统相关性方法，并构建了覆盖10种语言、4个评估维度的大规模多语言风格个性化文本生成基准来检验指标的真实评估能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a regression-based meta-evaluation framework that replaces metric-human correlations with learned prediction of human ratings, and introduces a large-scale multilingual style-personalized text generation benchmark spanning 10 languages and 4 evaluation dimensions to measure metric capability.
